project.name: mediconnect-operations-patient-portal
project.description: Multi-role medical practice and patient engagement mobile app with triage queues, appointments, prescriptions, messaging workflows and OCR expense management.
project.target: React Mobile (Expo, TypeScript, Functional Components, Hooks)

skills.name: react-translator
skills.reason: Framework is React Mobile (Expo, TypeScript); translate description into React Native seed conventions.

skills.name: react-architect
skills.reason: Structural decisions for the React Native blackboard architecture.

skills.name: react-wiring
skills.reason: Navigation, providers and entry point wiring with React Navigation.

skills.name: react-ui
skills.reason: Flexbox layoutSpec and design system application.

skills.name: react-core
skills.reason: Services, stores and context for ERP, access control, messaging and OCR.

skills.name: react-container
skills.reason: Screens and components, Expo Stage 0 bootstrap.

global_requirements.layout: Vertical flexbox stack inside SafeAreaView: top header with profile switcher, location and notification badge, role-adaptive bottom tab navigation, stack navigation for drill-down screens, sticky bottom action bar.

theme.iconography: custom icons for appointment types, pharmacy dispatches and financial receipts

items: role switcher and profile header card
flex.responsive: useWindowDimensions; phone single column, tablet two-column content with numColumns on lists

core_services: Hospital ERP Ingestion & Triage Engine — ingests patient recommendation queues and calculates priority score (0-10) from severity and diagnosis, ranking the queue
Role & Access Control Service — manages role sessions (PATIENT_SOCIAL_SECURITY, PATIENT_PRIVATE, DOCTOR, NURSE, SECRETARY) and enforces field-level access, adapting tabs and views
Omnichannel Messaging Gateway — dispatches WhatsApp templates and tracks manual doctor follow-up calls
Financial & OCR Invoice Service — mock OCR of receipt photos extracting vendor, tax ID, totals and line items; maintains monthly ledger balances

shared_ui.name: RoleSwitcherHeader
shared_ui.purpose: Top safe-area header to toggle between Patient, Doctor and Staff views, showing location and pending notification badge.
shared_ui.content: elements: profile segmented switcher, location indicator, notification badge; data: active role, location, pending notification count; states: patient | doctor | staff; interactions: tap to switch role; a11y: accessibilityRole=button, min 44x44pt targets, badge count announced
shared_ui.a11y: accessibilityLabel on switcher options, accessibilityState selected, 44x44pt touch targets.

shared_ui.name: PriorityTriageBadge
shared_ui.purpose: Color-coded urgency indicator with raw numeric score.
shared_ui.content: elements: rank label, score number; data: severity URGENT|HIGH|MEDIUM|ROUTINE, score 0-10; states: urgent(#EF4444) | high(#F59E0B) | medium | routine; interactions: none; a11y: accessibilityValue announces rank and score
shared_ui.a11y: WCAG AA contrast; accessibilityLabel and accessibilityValue announce rank explicitly.

shared_ui.name: AppointmentStatusTimeline
shared_ui.purpose: Visual progress tracker of appointment states.
shared_ui.content: elements: step nodes, connectors; data: PENDING_TRIAGE, SCHEDULED, WHATSAPP_SENT, CALL_REQUIRED, CONFIRMED, IN_CONSULTATION, COMPLETED; states: completed | current | upcoming; interactions: none; a11y: current step announced

shared_ui.name: PrescriptionPharmacyStatusCard
shared_ui.purpose: Card showing medication, dosage, issuing doctor and pharmacy dispatch status.
shared_ui.content: elements: medication name, dosage, doctor, status chip; data: ISSUED | DISPATCHED_TO_PHARMACY | READY_FOR_PICKUP; states: issued | dispatched | ready; interactions: tap to open prescription detail; a11y: status announced
shared_ui.a11y: accessibilityRole=button, accessibilityLabel combining medication and status.

shared_ui.name: OcrScanPreview
shared_ui.purpose: Camera viewfinder container with bounding box overlays of extracted receipt fields.
shared_ui.content: elements: viewfinder frame, bounding box overlays, extracted field labels; data: vendor, tax ID, totals, line items, confidence; states: idle | scanning_ocr | verified; interactions: capture, edit extracted fields; a11y: extracted fields read out
shared_ui.a11y: accessibilityLabel describing extracted fields and confidence; editable fields with labels.

features.name: clinical-agenda
features.description: Central operational dashboard for doctors, nurses and secretaries: ERP-prioritized patient queue, doctor availability slots, consultations versus surgical procedures. Views: vertical priority list, calendar day/week, appointment modifier modal. States: loading | empty | error | success. Toast on new high-priority patient, confirmation dialogs on schedule override, swipeable cards (Send WhatsApp, Require Call, Reschedule), pull-to-refresh.
actions: Fetch priority-ranked queue from hospital ERP
Assign available time slot based on priority score
Modify appointment time or reassign doctor
Switch view filter between consultations and surgical procedures

features.name: patient-portal
features.description: Patient-facing self-service for appointment requests, history, active prescriptions, pharmacy dispatch notifications, specialist referrals and lab requests. Views: patient dashboard stack, prescription detail, test order list. States: loading | empty | error | success. Banner notifications; bottom tabs My Appointments, Prescriptions, Exams/Referrals; high-contrast simplified layouts.
actions: Fetch active prescriptions and pharmacy status
View pending specialist referrals and lab exam requests
Toggle reminder notifications (24h before / day of appointment)

features.name: messaging-hub
features.description: Coordinates automated and manual outreach: WhatsApp confirmations to patients and doctor call alerts for high-priority or surgical appointments. Views: staff action item list, call queue detail bar. States: idle | dispatching | sent | call_pending | call_completed. Delivery checkmarks, persistent pending-call badge, one-tap native WhatsApp or phone dialer.

features.name: financial-ledger
features.description: Financial module for monthly invoices and practice expenses; register costs manually or by photographing a receipt with mock OCR. Views: financial summary dashboard, expense itemizer list, receipt scanner. States: loading | scanning_ocr | verified | saving | error. Editable OCR-extracted fields, FAB to scan, horizontal swipe to delete manual entries, readout of totals and tax.
actions: Fetch monthly financial overview (issued invoices vs expenses)
Process receipt image via mock OCR parser
Save verified expense entry to accounting ledger
Manually create or edit financial expense record
